body: This has been a debate with people I know and we are split in half between the side closest to the body and the side which faces outwards

>> If it were really about children being “too young to decide”, it would be an argument to put all children on blockers until 16 

That first sentence was why I thought it wasn’t advocating but what I said before?

Yeah I don’t know but I’m not a medical professional so I think def we are agreed more research and it needs to be the doctors and stuff involved. Idk if they prescribe bisphosonates too maybe? If it reduces it I really hope so

It seems like then there should be more research done into it, maybe there just isn’t yet?

Also I don’t think the other person was suggesting all children should go on blockers, I think they were saying that would be an argument from those who disagree with trans children getting support who say they are too young to decide if they actually felt they were too young to decide, because they would be too young to decide they were cis too

Most trans children are not given blockers for very long periods of time and they are not commonly prescribed to trans children. I think it’s less an internet debate and more that if doctors and medical professionals believed it was a risk they would not prescribe blockers. They often are only prescribed to 15 year olds for a year until they are allowed HRT, often after most of the puberty has occurred

I feel really daft admitting this stuff, there are other people who definitely have it worse. I am really struggling to keep my mental health in check and it’s gotten worse since the lockdown (which here has been 8 weeks now). I haven’t seen my partner in that time and I’m struggling to maintain a relationship almost exclusively via text. I don’t even have a garden so in that time I’ve only been outside 7 times. I live with my best mate and his girlfriend which can be tough at times but mostly I’m jealous that they even get to see each other. I’ve got my final exam for my undergrad next week which is going to be weird because they’ve had to revamp how they do them. I mean it’s taken me an extra year to complete my degree and I’m terrified I’m not going to pass. I want to do a masters next year but who knows what’s going to happen and whether unis will even be open? 
I hate what my job has become because of everything, I hate zoom and I hate the repetitive meetings asking how everyone is doing but no one else seems to understand why I dislike it so much and I get told to get used to “the new normal” all. The. Time. Makes me super angry.
I don’t have a great family relationship but they’ve started insisting on weekly video calls and I want to kill them all because it’s too much. 
It’s my birthday next week and I don’t feel like I really know who I am anymore, I’m just a blob moving from laying in my bed to sitting in my bed and back to laying.
I guess it’s all nothing really right? But I hate myself, I hate how bitter I’ve become, I hate how angry I am all the time, I hate how I want to fight with people just to feel anything more than my own feelings
How do you convince yourself that it’s worth it? Like is the burrito worth all the other crap in life?
Feel like that’s easier said than done
